summary: Learn to prioritise change demand, model capacity and track portfolio benefits. Explore the five-day enterprise change governance course.
lede: Change portfolio management training helps change, PMO, strategy, HR and transformation leaders govern concurrent initiatives against priorities and delivery capacity. They practise assessing demand, prioritising initiatives, modelling capacity in Excel, mapping workforce impacts with the Prosci ADKAR Model, and tracking benefits through Balanced Scorecard measures and executive reporting.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who coordinate, govern or sponsor concurrent transformation initiatives and need to connect portfolio decisions with delivery capacity, workforce impacts and strategic outcomes.
modules: Excel Change Capacity and Demand Models
prerequisites: Experience contributing to organisational change, transformation, PMO, HR and organisational development, or strategy work is expected. No coding is required; spreadsheet familiarity will support the Excel capacity exercises.
